notes: Version 2.0.0 — major corrective revision. This version supersedes version 1.1.1 and withdraws its claim that the admissibility contract selects a finite Heisenberg carrier. Minimal generation by an involutively exchanged pair, faithful irreducibility, unitarity, and a non-trivial commutator do not imply that the commutator is central: the integrated S3 countermodel satisfies the full extracted contract and violates centrality. The valid irreducibility-to-non-commutation result and the conditional Stone–von Neumann endpoint are retained. The revision also corrects the prime-order argument, distinguishes the Heisenberg carrier H_c from the associated Weil module V_rho, and identifies two sufficient positive routes based on covariant imprimitivity or supplied symplectic data. The previously separate countermodel note was withdrawn; its result is integrated and reviewed here.
